name: update_plan
description:
Writes or updates the project plan document stored in agent memory.
Use when: creating an initial plan, revising scope, or updating the current approach after major decisions.
Scope: local filesystem (plan.md in memory dir). No network access.
Not for: tracking milestone status (use update_milestones), logging decisions per-session (use memory_checkpoint), or reading the plan back (use restore_session).

content.description: Full markdown content for the plan. Replaces existing plan unless append=true.

append.description: If true, append content to the existing plan instead of replacing it. Default: false.
